build_task_to_xml: build a function that maps a task name string to its corresponding MuJoCo XML scene path
create_feet_sites: create a list of foot site names for the Berkeley Humanoid locomotion environment
create_feet_geoms: create a combined list of left and right foot geom names for collision and sensing
create_sensor_constants: create sensor name constants for gravity, linear velocity, angular velocity, accelerometer, and gyro
create_terrain_xml_paths: create file paths to flat and rough terrain MuJoCo XML scene files
